inputs.text: Wake up and look past the surface script they are feeding us. The mainstream channels keep pushing this fabricated story about the DHS announcing the arrest of an illegal immigrant gang member by ICE after he was released by New York City authorities despite posing a danger to public safety. They desperately want us to swallow the narrative that this is merely a routine clash over sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement, highlighting how DHS criticized the city's actions and pointed to the potential public safety risks of releasing individuals with criminal records. It is all a massive theatrical production, a smoke screen designed to keep the public blind while the unseen puppet masters coordinate every move behind the curtain to advance their true agenda.
